title: PipelineStepCatalogResponse
description: GET /api/pipeline-step-catalog response body (HEL-1136) -- every registered PipelineStep.Registry kind, plus the declared display order of their groups. `groups` and `steps` are ORDERED ARRAYS, never conveyed via object-key order (design.md Decision 3).

groups.description: Every declared StepGroup, in the backend's declared display order.

steps.description: One entry per PipelineStep.Registry kind -- exactly one per kind, no kind omitted.

description.description: A one-line, user-facing description of what this step does.

group.description: The declared group's id, e.g. "filter-shape". ABSENT (not null) when the kind declares no group -- an ungrouped kind is a permanent, valid state, not an error.

authorable.description: Whether a client may offer this kind as a choice the user can create and configure. false for a registered-but-no-authoring-surface kind (e.g. join, groupby).
